exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the correct form of the present simple.
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni Present Simple ning to'g'ri shakliga qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
MATN MAYKL haqida — 10 yoshli bola, Nyu-Yorkda yashaydi.

HAR BIR BO'SHLIQ UCHUN:
  1) Ega kim? (Michael / He — 3-shaxs birlik)
  2) Gap tasdiqmi yoki inkormi?
  3) Fe'l qanday shakl oladi?

DIQQAT — bu matnda deyarli hamma yerda 'He/Michael' —
ya'ni 3-SHAXS BIRLIK. Demak fe'llar -s oladi.

ISTISNOLAR:
  (be)       → is    (am/are/is — noto'g'ri fe'l)
  (have got) → has got
  (not/have) → hasn't got  (inkor)

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  complexion — teri rangi, yuz rangi
  a lawyer   — yurist, advokat
  professional — professional, kasbiy
  a lot      — ko'p, juda
  from ... till ... — ...dan ...gacha

lines.whyUz: 'to be' noto'g'ri fe'l: I am, you are, he IS. Yosh 'be' bilan aytiladi.

lines.textEn: He 2) ____ (have got) short dark hair, brown eyes and a dark complexion.
Michael 3) ____ (live) in New York City with his family.
His father is a teacher and his mother is a lawyer.

lines.whyUz:
Inkor: has + not → hasn't got. 'doesn't have' ham to'g'ri, lekin matnda 'have got' qolipi ishlatilgan.
'any' — inkor gapda ko'plik ot bilan (Unit 3).

lines.textEn: ... and 6) ____ (want) to be a professional basketball player.
He 8) ____ (go) every day from 9 am till 3:30pm.
lines.whyUz: -o → -es: goes. 'every day' — Present Simple vaqt iborasi.

lines.textEn: In his free time, Michael 9) ____ (love) playing computer games ...

lines.whyUz: 'enjoy' — o (unli) + y → oddiy -s. 'enjoies' XATO. 'enjoy' dan keyin ham -ING.

exercises.instructionEn: Rewrite the sentences in the negative and interrogative, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Gaplarni inkor va so'roq shaklida qayta yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
NAMUNA:
  He works at a hospital.
  → He doesn't work at a hospital.   (inkor)
  → Does he work at a hospital?      (savol)

DIQQAT — ikkala shaklda ham -s TUSHADI:
  works → doesn't WORK / Does he WORK?

YORDAMCHI FE'L TANLASH:
  he/she/it → doesn't / Does
  I/you/we/they → don't / Do

ISTISNO — 'to be' fe'li:
  Their father IS a firefighter.
  → Their father ISN'T a firefighter.  (do/does KERAK EMAS)
  → IS their father a firefighter?     (fe'l oldinga chiqadi)

'to be' bilan hech qachon do/does ishlatilmaydi!

example.speaker: 1 inkor
example.en: He doesn't work at a hospital.

example.speaker: 1 savol
example.en: Does he work at a hospital?

5. Their father is a firefighter. — SAVOL

exercises.explanationUz:
TAKRORLASH — 1, 2, 3 va 4-unitlarning barcha grammatikasi:

  Unit 1: to be, a/an, kelib chiqish (from), kasb
  Unit 2: have got, can, tashqi ko'rinish
  Unit 3: there is/are, some/any, o'rin predloglari
  Unit 4: olmoshlar, egalik, Who's/Whose, Present Simple

Xato qilsangiz — o'sha unit qoidasini qayta ko'rib chiqing.

items.whyUz: 'the capital OF' — turg'un birikma. Varshava — Polshaning poytaxti.
'pilot' /p/ undosh tovush bilan boshlanadi → a. Kasb oldida artikl SHART.

items.textEn: 3  Are they from Spain? No, they ____ .

items.whyUz: 'have got' — egalik. 'I've got' = I have got. 'I'm got' XATO.

items.textEn: 5  There are ____ flowers in the vase.
6  He ____ swim but he can cook.
items.whyUz: 'but he CAN cook' — demak birinchi qism INKOR: can't swim.
Bitta o'g'il, ikki ota-ona → 's faqat OXIRGI ismga (Unit 4).

items.textEn: 10  There is a large garage ____ the house.
items.whyUz: Garaj odatda uyning ORQASIDA. 'on the house' — tomida degani, 'in the house' — ichida.
Javob 'Ann's father' — odamning kimligi → Who is.

items.textEn: 13  My mother ____ going to the theatre.

items.whyUz: Egalik kerak → John + 's. 'him' obyekt olmoshi, 'he' ega olmoshi — ikkalasi ham mos emas.

items.textEn: 15  I can see ____ car in the street.
16  There is a study ____ the attic.

items.whyUz: Ot yo'q → EGALIK OLMOSHI 'his'. 'sunglasses' ko'plik bo'lsa ham 'his' o'zgarmaydi.

wordFormation.introUz: Grammar Book 21-bet — matn lug'ati va takrorlash so'zlari.

groups.ruleUz: Inkor va savol — do/does bilan yoki 'to be' bilan
groups.explanationUz: Eng muhim farq: 'to be' fe'li bilan do/does ISHLATILMAYDI.

items.derived: He doesn't work. / Does he work?
He isn't a teacher. / Is he a teacher?
He hasn't got a car. / Has he got a car?
He can't swim. / Can he swim?

groups.explanationUz: Bu birikmalarda predlog o'zgarmaydi — butun holda yodlanadi.
Bu otlar birlikda ishlatilmaydi — juft narsalarni bildiradi.

patterns.exampleEn: Michael lives in New York City. He goes every day.
patterns.exampleUz: Maykl Nyu-York shahrida yashaydi. U har kuni boradi.

patterns.exampleEn: He doesn't work at a hospital. They don't watch TV in the evenings.
patterns.exampleUz: U kasalxonada ishlamaydi. Ular kechqurunlari televizor ko'rmaydi.
patterns.explanationUz: Inkorda -s tushadi. 3-shaxs birlikda doesn't, qolganlarda don't.

patterns.exampleEn: Does he work at a hospital? Do they watch TV in the evenings?
patterns.exampleUz: U kasalxonada ishlaydimi? Ular kechqurunlari televizor ko'radimi?

patterns.formula: 'to be' bilan inkor va savol — do/does KERAK EMAS.
patterns.exampleEn: Their father isn't a firefighter. Is their father a firefighter?
patterns.exampleUz: Ularning otasi o't o'chiruvchi emas. Ularning otasi o't o'chiruvchimi?
patterns.explanationUz:
'to be' o'zi yordamchi fe'l — u to'g'ridan-to'g'ri 'not' oladi
va savolda oldinga chiqadi.

patterns.exampleEn: He has got short dark hair. Michael hasn't got any brothers or sisters.
patterns.exampleUz: Uning sochi kalta va to'q rangli. Mayklning aka-uka va opa-singillari yo'q.

patterns.exampleEn: He wants to be a professional basketball player.
patterns.explanationUz: 'want' dan keyin 'to' + fe'l. Kasb oldida 'a' shart.
